summary: Everything under the sun is vanity and vexation of spirit—He who increases in knowledge increases in sorrow.
title: Ecclesiastes or, the Preacher
meta_description: Everything under the sun is vanity and vexation of spirit—He who increases in knowledge increases in sorrow.

footnotes.note13_b: HEB (literally) “evil business”; i.e., that which is of little profit. Eccl. 4:8.
footnotes.note14_b: HEB striving after wind; thus, frustration. Eccl. 2:17 (17, 26); 4:4 (4, 6, 16); 6:9.
